latestVersion.changelog:
Subtitle Generator Green skill — initial release!

- Automatically adds green-colored subtitles to uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Cloud-based processing — no local software required.
- Simple setup: connects to backend, retrieves access token if needed, and starts session automatically.
- Supports fast video exports (about 30–60 seconds for a 2-minute clip) at up to 1080p.
- Includes commands for uploading, exporting, checking credits, and managing session state.
- Clear feedback and error handling for uploads, exports, and account issues.
